title.en: After two decades, China is preparing its boldest Moon mission yet
title.zh: 二十年后，中国正在准备迄今为止最大胆的月球任务

summary.en: China's ambitious space program will take it to the moon as soon as next month, and it's looking for water.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
How do you explore a place where the sun never shines? China's space program will soon embark on one of the most innovative lunar exploration missions in recent years.

We’ve known for nearly two decades that some form of water exists on the moon. What we still don’t know is exactly how much accessible water ice lies inside permanently shadowed craters, how deeply it is buried or what form it takes.

What we do know is that accessing that water ice will be a real challenge: it is found at the bottom of deep, hard-to-traverse craters where the sun never shines, remaining untouched for billions of years at temperatures well below –200C. These are among the most valuable places on the moon, but the hardest to reach and explore.

Lunar exploration has come a long way since the Soviet Union’s Luna-1 probe reached the moon's vicinity in January 1959. The Apollo missions and their successors showed the challenge is no longer simply to reach the moon. It is to explore places human and conventional rovers cannot easily go, and ultimately determine whether the moon itself can provide some of the resources that future explorers will need.

China has spent two decades building an increasingly ambitious lunar exploration program, named after Chang'e, the ancient Chinese goddess of the moon. The Chang'e-7 mission is expected to set course for our celestial neighbour later this month, although a recent failure involving a different Chinese rocket has introduced some uncertainty over the launch date. Here’s what makes this latest mission so interesting.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The mission will test several novel approaches to lunar exploration. It will consist of an orbiter, a lander, a rover and a hopper.

In addition, the Queqiao-2 lunar relay satellite is already in place. Launched separately in March 2024, it subsequently supported the Chang'e-6 mission and will facilitate communication between Earth and the lunar surface during the Chang'e-7 mission.

We don’t know precisely where the mission will land, but a site on or near an illuminated ridge close to the Shackleton crater in the Lunar South Pole’s Aitken region is a prime candidate.

The hopper will be the mission’s real star. Unlike a wheeled rover, it’s designed to leap over broken terrain and descend into craters where sunlight never reaches, places conventional vehicles may simply be unable to enter.

Adding it to the mission makes sense, given the steep crater walls, broken terrain, permanent shadow and the need for autonomous navigation and communications.

body.zh: 如何探索一个阳光照不到的地方？中国的太空计划很快将启动近年来最具创新性的月球探测任务之一。 近二十年来，我们已经知道月球上存在某种形式的水。我们仍然不知道的是，在永久阴影的陨石坑内到底有多少可接近的水冰，它埋藏的深度有多深，或者它的形式是什么。 我们所知道的是，获取这些水冰将是一个真正的挑战：它是在难以穿越的深坑底部发现的，那里的阳光永远不会照射到，在远低于零下200摄氏度的温度下数十亿年都保持不变。这些是月球上最有价值的地方，但也是最难到达和探索的地方。 自 1959 年 1 月苏联的 Luna-1 探测器到达月球附近以来，月球探索已经取得了长足的进步。阿波罗任务及其后续任务表明，挑战不再仅仅是到达月球。它是为了探索人类和传统漫游车无法轻易到达的地方，并最终确定月球本身是否可以提供未来探险者所需的一些资源。 中国花了二十年的时间制定了一项日益雄心勃勃的月球探测计划，该计划以中国古代月亮女神嫦娥的名字命名。嫦娥七号任务预计将于本月晚些时候飞往我们的天体邻居，尽管最近另一枚中国火箭的失败给发射日期带来了一些不确定性。这就是这个最新任务如此有趣的原因。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 该任务将测试几种月球探索的新方法。它将由轨道飞行器、着陆器、漫游车和漏斗组成。 此外，鹊桥二号月球中继卫星也已就位。它于2024年3月单独发射，随后支持嫦娥六号任务，并将在嫦娥七号任务期间促进地球与月球表面之间的通信。 我们不知道任务将在哪里着陆，但月球南极艾特肯地区靠近沙克尔顿陨石坑的照明山脊上或附近的一个地点是主要候选地点。 漏斗将成为这次任务的真正明星。与轮式漫游车不同，它的设计目的是跳过破碎的地形并下降到阳光永远无法到达的陨石坑中，而传统车辆可能根本无法进入这些地方。 考虑到陡峭的火山口壁、破碎的地形、永久的阴影以及自主导航和通信的需求，将其添加到任务中是有意义的。 中国科学家不会寻找水的迹象；而是寻找水的迹象。我们...

summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Police are investigating the death of a woman who was struck by a car that crashed into a restaurant at Westfield Knox in Wantirna South in Melbourne’s east.

The National Reconstruction Fund will invest $120m into a $240m advanced manufacturing project north of Perth expected to be able to build 2,000 apartments a year once fully operational.

A second long-nosed fur seal is suspected to have died in South Australia from H5 bird flu, just a day after officials confirmed the first death of a mammal on the Australian mainland.

Leah Stewart , the woman who was bitten by a shark at Sydney’s Coogee beach in June, issued an update on GoFundMe yesterday, thanking the community for its support during her recovery.

Barnaby Joyce says a fellow One Nation MP made a mistake on Sunday by suggesting the minor party’s migration numbers would not be much different to Labor’s.

Australia’s unemployment payments have fallen so far behind the pension they now amount to just 68% of the payment, a new research paper released today by the Australian Council for Social Services has revealed.

KPMG Australia is cutting 27 partners and about 360 employees in the wake of an audit leaks scandal that saw it cut off from new government contracts.

The NSW premier, Chris Minns , says he supports extending the royal commission on antisemitism after calls for an extension by the federal opposition were rejected by the Albanese government.

The AFL CEO, Andrew Dillon, says the five players stood down by the Sydney Swans won’t be invited to the Brownlow medal awards night .

Five people have been taken into custody and two have been charged after Victoria police investigating alleged union corruption raided properties including the headquarters of the CFMEU.

Anthony Albanese said there will be “no change” to WA’s share of the GST while he is prime minister.
body.zh: 警方正在调查一名妇女因汽车撞向墨尔本东部万提那南 Westfield Knox 的一家餐厅而死亡。 国家重建基金将向珀斯北部价值 2.4 亿美元的先进制造项目投资 1.2 亿美元，预计全面运营后每年能够建造 2,000 套公寓。 就在官员确认澳大利亚大陆首例哺乳动物死亡的一天后，南澳大利亚第二只长鼻海豹疑似死于 H5 禽流感。 6 月在悉尼库吉海滩被鲨鱼咬伤的女性 Leah Stewart 昨天在 GoFundMe 上发布了最新消息，感谢社区在她康复期间给予的支持。 巴纳比·乔伊斯 (Barnaby Joyce) 表示，一位同为一国党的议员周日犯了一个错误，他暗示该小党的移民人数与工党的移民人数不会有太大差异。 澳大利亚社会服务委员会今天发布的一份新研究报告显示，澳大利亚的失业金远远落后于养老金，目前仅占失业金的 68%。 毕马威澳大利亚公司在审计泄密丑闻导致其与新政府合同被切断后，正在裁员 27 名合伙人以及约 360 名员工。 新南威尔士州州长克里斯·明斯 (Chris Minns) 表示，在联邦反对派提出的延长反犹太主义委员会的要求遭到阿尔巴尼亚政府拒绝后，他支持延长皇家反犹太主义委员会的期限。 AFL 首席执行官安德鲁·狄龙 (Andrew Dillon) 表示，被悉尼天鹅队淘汰的五名球员将不会被邀请参加布朗洛奖牌颁奖之夜。 调查涉嫌工会腐败的维州警方突击搜查了包括 CFMEU 总部在内的财产，五人被拘留，两人被指控。 安东尼·艾博尼斯 (Anthony Albanese) 表示，在他担任总理期间，西澳所占的商品及服务税份额将“不会改变”。

title.en: 130,000 or 230,000? The migration figures One Nation is trying to explain
title.zh: 13万还是23万？一国组织试图解释的移民数据

summary.en: Conflicting comments from One Nation figures have raised questions about the party's migration target.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
One Nation MP Barnaby Joyce has faced questions over his party's immigration target, claiming fellow MP David Farley misspoke when he revealed their figures were "not too different" from Labor's.

The MP for Farrer told ABC's Insiders program on Sunday that One Nation's stated figure of 130,000 net overseas migration annually into Australia did not include those who enter under a Pacific labour scheme, aged-care nurses, and other in-demand skilled workers.

He conceded that those groups would add roughly 100,000 people, bringing their total to 230,000 — 5,000 fewer than the current Labor budget projections.

Party leader Pauline Hanson intervened just hours later, writing on social media that One Nation's policy is to reduce net overseas migration (NOM) to 130,000.

Speaking to Channel Seven's Sunrise program on Monday, Joyce added that Farley simply made a mistake while explaining the numbers.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"Show me a political career where people haven't made a mistake, and I'll show you a person who's not told the truth," Joyce said.

"I'm not going to throw anybody under a bus. When people are new in parliament, they can sometimes get things incorrect, and that's what happens. God knows, I've done it enough."

The debate over Australia's migration figures has intensified in recent months, with a recent Redbridge/Accent Research poll, conducted for the Australian Financial Review, indicating that voters trust One Nation and its traditionally restrictive approach to handle migration better than Labor or the Liberal Party.

However, the disjointed nature of One Nation's ongoing public discourse on the topic has prompted claims that the party is "incoherent" and "not fit to govern" from federal minister Pat Conroy.

Since its 1997 inception, cutting immigration has been seemingly a foundational pillar of One Nation policy. During her first speech to federal parliament, Hanson alleged Australia was in danger of being "swamped by Asians", that migrants never assimilated, and that multiculturalism should be abolished.

Its website currently states One Nation would "cut immigration by over 570,000 people" through "capping visas at 130,000 per year".

In a social media post on Sunday, Hanson wrote that NOM would be cut to 130,000 — a figure the party has previously clarified to SBS News . This number would be achieved by reducing international students, temporary graduate visas, and a "much more targeted" skilled migration program, Hanson said.

Those figures are different to the ones put forward by Farley, who said One Nation is focusing on "the NOM in its true form", as separate to labour programs "that drive our...
body.zh: 一国党议员巴纳比·乔伊斯 (Barnaby Joyce) 面临有关该党移民目标的质疑，声称同僚议员戴维·法利 (David Farley) 在透露他们的数字与工党的数字“相差不大”时说错了话。 法雷尔议员周日告诉美国广播公司的 Insiders 节目，一国党公布的每年有 13 万名海外净移民进入澳大利亚的数字不包括根据太平洋劳工计划进入的人、老年护理护士和其他急需的技术工人。 他承认这些团体将增加大约 10 万人，使总人数达到 23 万人——比当前工党预算预测少 5,000 人。 几小时后，该党领导人保琳·汉森(Pauline Hanson)介入，她在社交媒体上写道，一国党的政策是将海外净移民(NOM)减少到13万人。 乔伊斯周一在第七频道的《日出》节目中补充说，法利只是在解释这些数字时犯了一个错误。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 乔伊斯说：“向我展示一个人们没有犯过错误的政治生涯，我就会向你展示一个没有说实话的人。” “我不会把任何人扔到公共汽车下。当人们刚进入议会时，他们有时会弄错事情，这就是发生的事情。上帝知道，我已经做得足够多了。” 近几个月来，有关澳大利亚移民数据的争论愈演愈烈，Redbridge/Accent Research 最近为《澳大利亚金融评论》进行的一项民意调查显示，选民相信一国党及其传统的限制性政策，能够比工党或自由党更好地处理移民问题。 然而，一国党持续就这一话题进行的公开讨论的脱节性质促使联邦部长帕特·康罗伊声称该党“语无伦次”且“不适合执政”。 自 1997 年推出以来，减少移民似乎一直是一国政策的基本支柱。汉森在联邦议会的第一次演讲中声称澳大利亚面临“被亚洲人淹没”的危险，移民永远不会被同化，多元文化主义应该被废除。 其网站目前表示，一国党将通过“每年 13 万个签证上限”来“减少超过 57 万移民”。 汉森在周日的社交媒体帖子中写道，NOM 将削减至 13 万人——该党此前已向 SBS 新闻澄清了这一数字。汉森表示，这一数字将通过减少国际学生、临时毕业生签证和“更有针对性”的技术移民计划来实现。 这些数字与法利提出的数字不同，法利表示，一国党正在关注“真正形式的 NOM”，与“推动我们……的劳工计划”分开。

title.en: Rush to vaccinate little penguins against H5N1 as another seal is diagnosed
title.zh: 又一海豹被确诊，赶紧为小企鹅接种 H5N1 疫苗

summary.en: A second seal has contracted the virus in South Australia, as Phillip Island rushes to vaccinate its iconic bird population.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Bird flu has likely spread to a second seal, one day after the first mammal in Australia was confirmed to have contracted the virus.

Five suspected H5 bird flu cases were recorded in South Australia on Monday, including a long-nosed fur seal at The Pages Conservation Park, the state's Department of Primary Industries and Regions said in a statement on Monday morning.

The Pages — which covers two small islands between Kangaroo Island and the mainland — is a haven for the endangered Australian sea lion.

The fur seal has been tested for bird flu, with results expected in the coming days.

The first positive case of the virus in a mammal was confirmed on Sunday in a long-nosed fur seal at Beachport, 300km south of Adelaide, which authorities believed was contracted from wild birds.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Before the new case was announced, Environment Minister Murray Watt said the spread from birds to mammals was inevitable and the government was examining whether further vaccination programs were needed.

"We are likely to see mass mortalities of birds and mammals, and I know that is a very distressing thing for Australians to hear. But we also need to be realistic," he told ABC TV on Monday.

"This is what we've seen happen overseas. Australia is very fortunate that we've been the last continent on Earth to have this strain of bird flu happen. But we are likely to see those kind of events as we have overseas."

Agriculture Minister Julie Collins said the federal government was investigating whether bird flu vaccines were available for use in mammals.

"There are trials underway in North America, in California and Hawaii, and this is using a vaccine that's been developed for cattle," she told ABC radio.

"There certainly is nothing commercially available, but we do continue to look at that research."

Bird flu vaccinations have been rolled out to at-risk species, including the little penguins on Victoria's Phillip Island.

Many were corralled into pens to receive the first of two vaccinations on Sunday night.

With case numbers on the rise, authorities have stepped in to do what they can to defend the 5,000-strong colony.

The penguins' nightly ritual of returning to the same burrow, along the same path, made them ideal candidates for vaccination, Phillip Island Nature Parks reserve manager Ben Thomas said.

As a world-first in scale, the process has taken some experimentation and fine-tuning.

"We've had our teams out late into the night for a week now and learning a lot along the process," Thomas said.

"We started on some of the quieter penguin pathways to fine-tune the whole process and get it working as quickly as we...

title.en: SBS WorldWatch is changing. Here's what viewers need to know
title.zh: SBS WorldWatch 正在发生变化。这是观众需要了解的内容

summary.en: The multilingual news service will cease broadcasting next month and continue exclusively online.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
SBS WorldWatch will soon become a digital-only service, ending its run as a broadcast television channel.

The multilingual news service, which provides news bulletins from international broadcasters, will move entirely to SBS On Demand .

SBS says the shift will allow it to increase the number of bulletins available in most languages.

From 18 September, the channel, which provides international news in 38 languages from 49 broadcasters worldwide, will cease broadcasting and all SBS WorldWatch programming will continue on SBS On Demand.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

As the channel closes, SBS WorldWatch will expand its existing digital service over the coming weeks to include two or more daily bulletins in most languages.

This is more content than could be accommodated on a single linear channel, SBS says, allowing audiences to watch bulletins as soon as they become available rather than waiting for a scheduled broadcast.

SBS On Demand also features two 24-hour FAST channels for English-language news — Euronews and France 24 .

SBS Director of News and Current Affairs, Mandi Wicks, said SBS WorldWatch played an important role in connecting Australians with news and perspectives from around the world, in their preferred language.

"Moving to SBS On Demand gives us the opportunity to build on that service, with more international news bulletins and greater flexibility for audiences to decide when and how they watch," she said.

"We recognise this will be a change for some audiences who are accustomed to watching SBS WorldWatch on linear television. We're committed to supporting them through the transition, while continuing to evolve our services for the future."

SBS is providing multilingual information and guidance through SBS Audio language programs and on SBS WorldWatch channel 35 ahead of the change.

Further information is available here , with additional support available via the SBS Help Centre .

The SBS WorldWatch — News In-Language hub can be found on the SBS On Demand homepage , where audiences can also search for content in their preferred language.

The full SBS On Demand offering features more than 15,000 hours of local and international programming across more than 60 languages, spanning news and current affairs, documentaries, drama, world movies, entertainment, food, children’s content and sport.

This includes dedicated language collections, as well as selected English-language programs with subtitles in Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, and Vietnamese.

title.en: 'Second chance at life': Sydney woman speaks publicly after surviving shark attack
title.zh: “第二次生命机会”：悉尼女子鲨鱼袭击幸存后首次公开讲话

summary.en: Leah Stewart, 34, a Sydney mother, has spoken publicly for the first time since surviving a shark attack over two months ago, attributing her "remarkable" recovery to community support. She expressed gratitude for the "army of love, support, prayers and encouragement" that helped her "get better, not bitter."
summary.zh: 34岁的悉尼母亲莉亚·斯图尔特在两个多月前鲨鱼袭击中幸存后首次公开讲话，她将自己“显著”的康复归功于社区的支持。她对“来自世界各地的爱、支持、祈祷和鼓励大军”表示感谢，这些帮助她“变得更好，而不是心怀怨恨”。

body.en:
A Sydney mother has spoken publicly for the first time since surviving a shark attack more than two months ago, crediting community support with helping her "get better, not bitter".

In a post on her GoFundMe donation page, Leah Stewart, 34, said she still had a long way to go, but her recovery had been "remarkable".

"A huge part of that is because of the absolute army of love, support, prayers and encouragement surrounding my family and I from all over the world," she said.

"That means more to me than I can say, and I truly believe it’s played a huge role in my recovery."

Stewart was swimming between the flags close to shore when she was attacked by a great white shark at Coogee Beach on 13 June.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

She was rushed to hospital in a critical condition, being induced in a coma and undergoing multiple surgeries, including the amputation of one of her arms.

The mother of one said she had been focused on her recovery and had "progressed enough to build some independence, and I can finally see some light after all of this".

"I want you to know that I feel like I’ve been given a second chance at life, and I’m not going to waste it. As I get better, I know I’ll make something of this second chance and aim to give back even more in generosity, care, and love. I will forever be grateful for everything, and everyone, I’ve been given," she said.

Stewart thanked those who had contributed to the fundraiser, which had reached more than $558,000, but it was time to turn donations off.

"What you’ve offered has given us enough to recover, to stay in our home, and to give us options for further medical treatment down the road," she said.

Sydney has experienced a spate of shark attacks this year, including three in just 48 hours in January.

On 18 January, 12-year-old Nico Antic was critically injured and later died after being attacked by a suspected bull shark while swimming off rocks in Vaucluse in Sydney Harbour.

The following day, Andre de Ruyter, 27, was attacked while surfing near Manly, suffering extreme blood loss and undergoing surgery to have one of his legs amputated.

An 11-year-old boy's surfboard was also bitten at Dee Why Beach on the same day, but the young surfer escaped injury.

After Stewart was attacked in June, NSW Premier Chris Minns said his government would invest an extra $34 million in drone coverage across NSW beaches.

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .

title.en: Enosh has a 10-year, $600,000 bet on the Australian dream
title.zh: Enosh 为澳大利亚梦下了 10 年 60 万美元的赌注

summary.en: For this young migrant, getting ahead means thinking differently about wealth.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Share your feedback and help us improve this feature. Read more about how we use AI at SBS here.

Should you invest in shares, or property? Is university still worth it, or should you start your own business? With the path to financial security becoming less clear, Insight asks how aspirational people are getting ahead, and whether Australia is a good country to build wealth. Watch Insight episode Gettin' Rich at 8.30PM Tuesday 25 August on SBS or SBS On Demand.

Enosh Tampoe, 23, and his family migrated from Sri Lanka 16 years ago and have been living in the same rental property since then.

The Sydney mortgage and finance adviser says that as an immigrant family "starting from scratch", he felt financially behind his friends at times growing up.

"There were situations where I did feel like [I was] potentially behind — just because at the end of the day, there is that intergenerational wealth ...You'll notice obviously, they have their own houses; they have nice cars ..." he told Insight.

"Having that support from parents — whether it's in the form of getting money or continuing to live at home rent-free and all that stuff — definitely helps."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Feeling he couldn't rely on the "whole natural pathway of doing well in school, getting through uni and [getting] a big boy job" to build wealth, he took a hard approach to saving at an early age and bought a Sydney apartment two years ago.

Now, he's giving himself 10 years to save a $600,000 deposit for a $3 million Sydney home where his whole family can live.

"My end goal is … that great Australian dream: owning my own home, building my family and raising them in a nice neighbourhood," he said.

To reach his goal faster, he lives with his parents and rents out his apartment — taking advantage of the tax benefits of negative gearing to build equity.

Negative gearing refers to a situation where the ongoing costs of an investment exceed the rental income received, and the overall loss can then be claimed as a tax deduction.

But as of 1 July 2027, the federal government will restrict the tax benefits of negative gearing to new residential builds.

Enosh says this new law has reduced his borrowing capacity by "around 20 per cent", putting his plans to buy a second investment property this year on hold.

"If I were to purchase a second investment property, I'm not getting that benefit towards my salary or wage, that tax benefit."

Leticia Coco also became a homeowner in her early 20s — when her mother died from cancer, and she and her brother inherited the family home.

title.en: The hidden underbelly of Australia's weight-loss drug boom
title.zh: 澳大利亚减肥药热潮背后隐藏的弱点

summary.en: Below the surface of Australia's weight-loss drug boom, a market operates outside the prescription system.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
For Kansasin Darwan, living in Bajool in central Queensland, the weight-loss injection was supposed to be a solution. Instead, she says, it left her barely able to function.

The 48-year-old says she had gained weight during perimenopause and believed her Australian GP was unlikely to prescribe a weight-management medicine because she did not meet the relevant clinical criteria.

In Australia, GLP-1 weight loss drugs are generally prescribed for chronic weight management in adults with a body mass index (BMI) of 30 or higher, or a BMI of 27 to under 30 with at least one weight-related health condition.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

So, while on holiday in her home country of Thailand, Darwan went to a beauty clinic in outer Bangkok and bought an injectable medicine branded as Mounjaro.

Beauty clinics in Thailand are generally supervised by doctors. However, the screening process for GLP-1 use can be less extensive than the assessment typically conducted by GPs in Australia. For example, some customers at beauty clinics may be prescribed GLP-1 drugs even if they do not have diabetes or are within a healthy weight range.

"I couldn't concentrate while driving. I wasn't feeling like myself. I couldn't sleep. Even my children noticed that I was different," she tells SBS Thai.

Eighteen out of every 1,000 Australians, or almost 2 per cent of the population, are now taking GLP-1s regularly, according to a study by scientists at the University of New South Wales (UNSW) published in November 2025.

Darwan's experience offers a glimpse into a fast-growing market for weight-loss injections, where some Australians are seeking access overseas, while others are obtaining medicines through social-media sellers and informal supply channels.

An investigation by SBS Thai found weight-loss medicines being offered without a doctor's prescription in Australian community groups, reports of products entering the country through informal channels, and unapproved peptides being marketed as weight-loss products.

But access to these medicines is not uniformly occurring outside the established medical system. Many Australians obtain weight-loss drugs through registered health professionals and pharmacies.

For consumers navigating this market, the distinction between an approved prescription medicine, an experimental drug and an unapproved product can be difficult to see — with experts and authorities warning that using medicines outside approved pathways can carry serious risks.

title.en: One Nation MP admits the party's true migration target 'isn't too different' from Labor's
title.zh: 一国党议员承认该党真正的移民目标与工党的“没有太大不同”

summary.en: Pauline Hanson has had to intervene after one MP's revised intake figure raised key questions.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
One Nation's immigration stance is under question after an MP said the party would include an extra 100,000 people annually in its policy — bringing its target total higher than present forecasts under Labor.

Farrer MP David Farley, who clinched Sussan Ley's old seat from the coalition at a by-election, told the ABC Insiders program on Sunday morning that his party had decided to separate a "true NOM", or net overseas migration figure, from certain other categories of migrants.

However, party leader Pauline Hanson was forced to quickly intervene, refuting the claims just hours later on social media. Party policy is to "cut net overseas migration to 130,000".

This contradicts messaging from Farley, who said One Nation's stated policy of getting net overseas migration down to 130,000 excluded people brought in under a Pacific scheme, aged-care nurses and other in-demand skilled workers.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Adding those groups would amount to an additional 100,000 arrivals, bringing the total to 230,000 — 5,000 more than the budget forecast of 225,000 in the coming four years.

"What we're doing is we're focusing on the NOM in its true form, and then we've got these programs that have been available now for over a decade that drive our economy," Farley told Insiders.

"The raw number is not too different, but the reality is, where do we need them?

"We don't need them in the great urban metroplex — we need them out to be productive, working in agriculture, engineering, mining."

The comments come as public debate continues around the optimum level of migration to Australia.

Net overseas migration dropped to 306,000 in 2024-25, brought down from a post-pandemic peak of 538,000 under Liberal-National government policy.

Cabinet minister Chris Bowen said net overseas migration could not just be redefined.

"My overwhelming conclusion was he's pretty comfortable with what the government's doing," Bowen told reporters.

"I'm not sure what campaign One Nation's going to run on migration if they're effectively backing in what the Albanese government is doing."

Opposition immigration spokesman Jonno Duniam said voters were owed a clear explanation of what the party's immigration policy actually is.

"These are not semantic distinctions. They have real consequences for housing, infrastructure, essential services, wages, jobs and the economy," he said.

"For a party that has spent years telling Australians it has all the answers on immigration, One Nation is having extraordinary difficulty answering the most basic question of all: how many migrants would actually come to Australia under its policy."

title.en: 'Link workers' help fight elderly loneliness
title.zh: “链接工作者”帮助对抗老年人的孤独感

summary.en: One of Ben Wong's clients is an elderly man who shunned others after his dog died. "At his home, there were only some instant noodles and alcohol," Wong spoke about his client's sense of isolation. The volunteer "link worker" noted it took him some time to gradually get the man...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: One of Ben Wong's clients is an elderly man who shunned others after his dog died. "At his home, there were only some instant noodles and alcohol," Wong spoke about his client's sense of isolation. The volunteer "link worker" noted it took him some time to gradually get the man to open up, revealing more about himself and his beloved four-legged companion. Among the activities planned was a funeral to allow his client to bid farewell to his dog. Accompanied by Wong, he also met with other dog owners and went to parks and markets. "We also took the elderly man to the district elderly community centre, and he even did rehearsals for the centre's Christmas party," Wong said. "He also started to do hotpots with other senior residents and said hi to his friends." Wong, who's in his fifties and an accountant by profession, is training to become a volunteer "link worker" to help elderly people fight their loneliness by linking them with the appropriate activity resources. He is among a batch of 60 "link workers" under a programme that offers "social prescriptions" for some 300 senior citizens in New Territories East, including Tin Shui Wai, Tun Mun and Yuen Long. "Social Prescribing Lab 2.0", to be launched next year, was organised by Make A Difference Institute, the city's first community-initiative public services innovation lab, to provide personalised services for those in need. The group said Hong Kong is grappling with a "loneliness epidemic", with one in five people reporting they feel lonely. That's higher than the global average of 16 percent. Roughly 520,000 Hongkongers also noted that they are "self-isolating", unwilling to confide in family, friends or even AI, according to surveys. "[For] many of the senior residents, actually they don't have the physical illnesses, what they really need is the 'social prescribing' to help them cope with loneliness," the institute's chairwoman Ada Wong said. Dicky Chow, assistant research director of the think tank, Our Hong Kong Foundation, highlighted the differences between social workers in general and these "social prescribing link workers". He said while social workers offer various types of services, "link workers" bring their clients to the actual social venues or help them access social resources. "'Social prescribing' is actually serving as a bridge between medical and social sectors," Chow said. "It's connecting the social sectors with the healthcare sectors, but at the same time, it is not [done] through just referrals, but more about accompanying the elderly, the patients... go through the whole journey with them. "And this is particularly helpful in solving a lot of health concerns, especially loneliness and chronic diseases, because they're actually affected by social determinants of health...
body.zh: Ben Wong 的一位客户是一位老人，在他的狗死后，他避开了其他人。 “在他的家里，只有一些方便面和酒，”黄谈到他的客户的孤立感。这位志愿者“链接工作人员”指出，他花了一些时间才逐渐让这名男子敞开心扉，透露更多关于他自己和他心爱的四足伙伴的信息。计划的活动之一是举行葬礼，让他的客户告别他的狗。在黄的陪同下，他还与其他狗主人会面，并去了公园和市场。黄说：“我们还带老人到区长者社区中心，他甚至为中心的圣诞晚会进行排练。” “他还开始和其他老人一起做火锅，并向朋友们打招呼。”黄先生五十多岁，职业是会计师，他正在接受培训，成为一名志愿者“联络员”，通过为老年人联系适当的活动资源来帮助他们克服孤独感。他是一项计划中的60名“联络员”之一，该计划为天水围、屯门和元朗等新界东约300名老年人提供“社会处方”。将于明年推出的“社会处方实验室2.0”是由Make A Difference Institute组织的，该实验室是该市第一个社区倡议的公共服务创新实验室，旨在为有需要的人提供个性化服务。该组织表示，香港正在应对“孤独流行病”，五分之一的人表示他们感到孤独。这高于 16% 的全球平均水平。调查显示，大约 52 万香港人还表示，他们正在“自我隔离”，不愿向家人、朋友甚至人工智能倾诉。 “对于许多老年居民来说，实际上他们并没有身体疾病，他们真正需要的是‘社会处方’来帮助他们应对孤独，”该研究所的主席 Ada Wong 说。团结香港基金智囊团助理研究主任周卫健强调了一般社会工作者与这些“社会处方链接工作者”之间的差异。他说，虽然社会工作者提供各种类型的服务，但“链接工作者”将他们的客户带到实际的社交场所或帮助他们获取社会资源。 “‘社会处方’实际上是医疗和社会部门之间的桥梁，”周说。 “它正在将社会部门与医疗部门联系起来，但同时，它不仅仅是通过转介来完成的，而是更多地陪伴老年人、患者……与他们一起经历整个旅程。“这对于解决很多健康问题特别有帮助，特别是孤独和慢性病，因为它们实际上受到健康的社会决定因素的影响......

title.en: China abruptly delays unmanned moon mission over ‘launch conditions’

summary.en: China’s manned space agency said on Sunday it is delaying a research moon mission that is part of Beijing’s efforts to land a crew there by 2030, less than two weeks after a rare launch failure. The agency said after a “comprehensive assessment” the mission, which involved...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: China’s manned space agency said on Sunday it is delaying a research moon mission that is part of Beijing’s efforts to land a crew there by 2030, less than two weeks after a rare launch failure. The Chang’e-7 lunar probe on a Long March 5 carrier rocket. Photo: CCTV screenshot. The agency said after a “comprehensive assessment” the mission, which involved sending the Chang’e-7 lunar probe on a Long March 5 carrier rocket, “does not meet launch conditions and cannot take place during the planned window this year”. The decision to delay was “based on the principle of prudence, reliability and absolute mission success,” it added, without providing further details on what conditions weren’t met or when the launch would be rescheduled. The mission — meant to search for water on the moon’s south pole — was scheduled to depart either over the weekend or Monday, according to media reports. Last week, the agency said the probe and carrier rocket had been moved to the takeoff area at Wenchang Space Launch Center in southern Hainan province. As of Wednesday, the takeoff site and equipment were in good condition, with inspections to take place and a launch “scheduled for the coming period”. The Chang’e-7 delay comes just under two weeks after media reports showed a rocket launched from the Hainan site had exploded, as crowds watched a fiery ball in the sky. The failed mission involved a Long March 7A carrier rocket, which had lifted off from the Wenchang Space Launch Site, state news agency Xinhua said at the time. China’s Long March 7A carrier rocket exploded on Monday, August 10, 2026. Photo: Supplied. An “anomaly” occurred when the rocket carrying the Zhongxing-4B communications satellite was in flight, Xinhua added. The cause of the failure was under investigation, it said. Beijing has ploughed billions of dollars into its space programme in recent years to achieve what President Xi Jinping calls the country’s “space dream”. China successfully landed a reusable rocket for the first time in July, according to its space agency, marking a major step in its space ambitions and in reducing launch costs. The country is aiming to land astronauts on the Moon before 2030, a race in which the United States is also competing with its Artemis programme.
body.zh: 中国载人航天局周日表示，将推迟一项研究月球任务，该任务是北京计划在 2030 年之前将宇航员送上月球的努力的一部分，距离一次罕见的发射失败还不到两周。长征五号运载火箭上的嫦娥七号月球探测器。照片：央视截图。该机构表示，经过“全面评估”，此次由长征五号运载火箭发射嫦娥七号月球探测器的任务“不符合发射条件，不能在今年计划的窗口期进行”。它补充说，推迟的决定是“基于审慎、可靠和任务绝对成功的原则”，但没有提供有关哪些条件不满足或何时重新安排发射的进一步细节。据媒体报道，该任务旨在在月球南极寻找水，计划在周末或周一出发。上周，该机构表示，探测器和运载火箭已转移至海南省南部文昌航天发射中心的起飞区。截至周三，起飞场地和设备状况良好，将进行检查并“计划在未来一段时间内”发射。嫦娥七号的发射推迟不到两周，此前媒体报道称，一枚从海南发射场发射的火箭发生爆炸，当时人群正在观看天空中的一个火球。官方通讯社新华社当时称，此次失败的任务涉及一枚从文昌航天发射场升空的长征七号甲运载火箭。中国的长征七号甲运载火箭于 2026 年 8 月 10 日星期一爆炸。照片：提供。新华社补充说，搭载中星四号B通信卫星的火箭在飞行过程中出现“异常”。声明称，故障原因正在调查中。近年来，北京已在太空计划上投入了数十亿美元，以实现习近平主席所说的国家“太空梦想”。据中国航天局称，中国于 7 月首次成功着陆可重复使用火箭，标志着其太空雄心和降低发射成本迈出了重要一步。该国的目标是在 2030 年之前将宇航员送上月球，美国也在这场竞赛中与其阿耳忒弥斯计划展开竞争。

summary.en: Shein will debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange on September 1, the fast-fashion retailer said on Monday, in a long-awaited listing that would value the group at close to US$27 billion. The online retailer plans to offer 280 million shares at a price between HK$47.60 and...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Shein will debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange on September 1, the fast-fashion retailer said on Monday, in a long-awaited listing that would value the group at close to US$27 billion. Shein app. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The online retailer plans to offer 280 million shares at a price between HK$47.60 and HK$49.50, raising up to HK$13.86 billion (US$1.7 billion), it said in a filing to the bourse. The final price will be announced on August 31, but the higher figure would value the company at around US$26.8 billion. Founded in China and now headquartered in Singapore, Shein finally won Beijing’s approval last month to make its initial public offering in Hong Kong. Plans to list in New York and London had been held back in recent years by regulatory hurdles, according to media reports. With most of its factories located in China, Shein sets itself apart from its competitors thanks to the speed of its product design and its highly efficient production and supply chain. Its vast selection of products at stunningly low prices has brought Shein into the same league as Amazon in the United States. With the funds raised from the market, Shein said it aims to finance its technological capabilities as well as boost its international presence. Growing scrutiny Shein reported a full-year net profit of US$2.06 billion in 2025 but swung to a $99 million quarterly loss as the United States scrapped an import duty exemption on small packages. The firm moved its headquarters to Singapore between 2021 and 2022, a move analysts say was intended to avoid increasing global scrutiny of Chinese firms. But it still benefits from China’s unique combination of a huge, low-cost textile manufacturing sector and a highly sophisticated e-commerce logistics network. The company ranks suppliers by their flexibility and ability to deliver urgent orders, and regularly eliminates the poorest performers, according to a 2021 Zhongtai Securities report. By the end of last year, its European customer base rose to 156 million average monthly users, making Shein one of the continent’s biggest e-commerce platforms alongside China’s AliExpress (193 million users) and Amazon (around 180 million). Shein has been scrutinised over its environmental footprint and allegations of human rights violations, though its executive chairman told AFP last year that the company has “zero tolerance” on forced labour. Activists from Mouv’Enfants, an association for the protection of children, stage a protest during the opening of Asian e-commerce giant Shein’s first physical store at the Bazar de l’Hotel de Ville (BHV) in Paris on November 5, 2025. Photo: Mouv’Enfants, via Facebook. Shein also drew criticism last year in France over the discovery of...
body.zh: 这家快时尚零售商周一表示，Shein 将于 9 月 1 日在香港证券交易所上市，这是一次期待已久的上市，该集团的估值将接近 270 亿美元。谢因应用程序。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。该在线零售商计划以 47.60 港元至 49.50 港元的价格发行 2.8 亿股股票，筹集至多 138.6 亿港元（17 亿美元）。最终价格将于 8 月 31 日公布，但较高的价格将使该公司估值约为 268 亿美元。 Shein 成立于中国，现总部位于新加坡，上个月终于获得北京方面的批准，在香港进行首次公开​​募股。据媒体报道，近年来在纽约和伦敦上市的计划因监管障碍而受阻。 Shein 的大部分工厂位于中国，凭借其产品设计速度以及高效的生产和供应链，使其在竞争对手中脱颖而出。 Shein 的产品种类繁多且价格极低，使其与美国的亚马逊处于同一水平。 Shein 表示，通过从市场筹集的资金，其目标是为其技术能力提供资金并提高其国际影响力。日益严格的审查 Shein 报告称，2025 年全年净利润为 20.6 亿美元，但由于美国取消小包装进口关税豁免，季度亏损 9,900 万美元。该公司在 2021 年至 2022 年间将总部迁至新加坡，分析师称此举是为了避免全球对中国公司日益严格的审查。但它仍然受益于中国庞大、低成本的纺织制造业和高度复杂的电子商务物流网络的独特结合。根据中泰证券 2021 年的报告，该公司根据供应商的灵活性和交付紧急订单的能力对供应商进行排名，并定期淘汰表现最差的供应商。截至去年年底，其欧洲客户群平均每月用户数增至 1.56 亿，使 Shein 成为欧洲大陆最大的电子商务平台之一，与中国的全球速卖通（1.93 亿用户）和亚马逊（约 1.8 亿用户）齐名。 Shein 因其环境足迹和侵犯人权的指控而受到审查，尽管其执行主席去年告诉法新社，该公司对强迫劳动采取“零容忍”态度。 2025 年 11 月 5 日，保护儿童协会 Mouv’Enfants 的活动人士在亚洲电子商务巨头 Shein 在巴黎 Bazar de l’Hotel de Ville (BHV) 的第一家实体店开业期间举行抗议。照片：Mouv’Enfants，来自 Facebook。谢因去年在法国也因发现……而受到批评。

title.en: Tai Po fire: Nearly 95% of Wang Fuk Court homeowners agree to gov’t buyback scheme
title.zh: 大埔火警：宏福苑近95%业主同意政府回购计划

summary.en: Close to 95 percent of homeowners at the fire-hit Wang Fuk Court have signed and returned a letter of acceptance indicating that they were willing to sell their flats to the government under an official buyback plan. As of August 21, 1,878 owners at the Tai Po estate have...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Close to 95 percent of homeowners at the fire-hit Wang Fuk Court have signed and returned a letter of acceptance indicating that they were willing to sell their flats to the government under an official buyback plan. Chris is one of the Wang Fuk Court residents who approached different government departments before the deadly fire in late November 2025. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. As of August 21, 1,878 owners at the Tai Po estate have expressed interest in the special property buyout scheme, under which their homes will be purchased by a company set up by the government, Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong said during a Commercial Radio programme on Sunday. That amounts to 94.7 per cent of the total 1,984 households at the estate. The government announced the buyback scheme in February, after a blaze tore through seven residential towers at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po on November 26 last year, killing 168 people and displacing thousands at the government-subsidised estate. Close to three-quarters – 74.1 per cent – of homeowners have also taken the next step in the process, signing a formal sale and purchase agreement with government-appointed estate administrators. These latest figures come one week before the government’s offer is set to expire on August 31. Wong told listeners that the date represents “a serious deadline” and warned that the government’s acquisition arrangements will close on schedule without any extensions or last-minute price increases. “If anyone says that we will extend the deadline, I want to make it clear here that we will not extend it… If I postpone this deadline, everything else will be affected,” Wong said. Wang Fuk Court residents attend a flat owners’ meeting at Tai Po Community Centre on July 19, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Under the buyout scheme, owners will be able to purchase a new home on the private market or move to another subsidised estate, either through cash or a flat-exchange exercise.
body.zh: 遭受火灾的宏福苑近95%的房主已签署并退回接受书，表明他们愿意根据官方回购计划将单位出售给政府。 Chris 是宏福苑居民之一，在 2025 年 11 月下旬发生致命火灾之前，曾与不同政府部门联系过。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。财政副司长黄伟纶周日在商业电台节目中表示，截至 8 月 21 日，大埔村已有 1,878 名业主表示对特别物业买断计划感兴趣，根据该计划，他们的房屋将由政府成立的公司购买。这相当于该庄园 1,984 户家庭的 94.7%。去年11月26日，大埔宏福苑发生大火，烧毁了七栋住宅楼，造成168人死亡，并导致该政府资助庄园内的数千人流离失所，之后，政府于2月宣布了回购计划。近四分之三（74.1%）的房主也采取了下一步行动，与政府指定的房地产管理人员签署了正式的买卖协议。这些最新数据是在政府的收购要约将于 8 月 31 日到期前一周公布的。黄告诉听众，这一日期代表着“一个严肃的最后期限”，并警告说，政府的收购安排将如期完成，不会有任何延期或最后一刻的价格上涨。 “如果有人说我们会延长最后期限，我想在这里明确表示，我们不会延长……如果我推迟这个最后期限，其他一切都会受到影响，”黄说。 2026 年 7 月 19 日，宏福苑居民参加在大埔社区中心举行的业主会议。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。根据买断计划，业主将能够通过现金或公寓交换活动在私人市场上购买新房或搬到另一个受补贴的房产。

body.en: Hong Kong authorities have launched a new booking system for visitors to a popular Sai Kung coastal trail, in a bid to better manage crowds and protect the natural environment. Po Pin Chau in Sai Kung’s High Island Geo Trail. Photo: GovHK. Registration began on Monday for sightseers looking to visit the Po Pin Chau section of the High Island Geo Trail next weekend, with a quota of 500 people set for each two-hour time slot. The trail is located in the south-eastern section of the Hong Kong UNESCO Global Geopark, near the High Island Reservoir East Dam. The booking-only area, however, does not cover the East Dam and Biu Tsim Kok sections. Bookings for Po Pin Chau will be required for all weekends beginning next month and ending October 7 – the final day of mainland China’s National Day Golden Week holiday, a peak travel season for visitors from across the border. This period also covers the Mid-Autumn Festival holiday next month. Registration is not required for bookings outside of those dates, or for visits before 9am and after 5pm. A map showing which areas will require advance reservation around Po Pin Chau. Photo: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department. The booking system is run by the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD), which looks after the territory’s country parks. Visitors must register using local online travel booking platform Klook with their real names, a requirement that authorities have said is intended to prevent scalping and no-shows. Registrants will receive an e-voucher with a QR code, which they must present to AFCD officers at the entrance of the Po Pin Chau section. Overcrowding Hong Kong’s popular nature spots have been grappling with overtourism, especially during peak travel seasons for mainland Chinese visitors. Ham Tin Beach in Sai Kung on May 2, 2026, the second day of the Labour Day Golden Week holiday in mainland China. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. In particular, some trails and beaches in Sai Kung – known for its scenic coastal views and natural landscapes – have seen major bottlenecks, as public transport has struggled to keep up with the surge in demand. Environmental groups have also warned of damage to ecological systems caused by overcrowding. Authorities first said in June that they were exploring the introduction of a real-name reservation system to improve visitor flow management at Po Pin Chau. Dianne Wong, under secretary for environment and ecology, said AFCD officers had been conducting crowd control by stopping people from entering when the number of visitors reached capacity, but this approach was not ideal for promoting eco-tourism in the city.
body.zh: 香港当局为前往热门西贡沿海步道的游客推出了新的预订系统，以更好地管理人群并保护自然环境。西贡万宜地质径的破边洲。照片：香港政府一站通。周一开始为下周末前往万宜地质径破边洲段的游客进行登记，每两小时时段的名额为 500 人。该径位于香港联合国教科文组织世界地质公园东南部，邻近万宜水库东坝。不过，只接受预订的区域并不包括东坝及标尖角路段。从下个月开始到 10 月 7 日（中国大陆国庆黄金周假期的最后一天）的所有周末，破边洲都需要预订，这是跨境游客的旅游旺季。此期间还涵盖下个月的中秋节假期。上述日期之外的预订或上午 9 点之前和下午 5 点之后的参观无需注册。地图显示破边洲周边哪些区域需要提前预约。相片：渔农自然护理署。该预订系统由负责管理本港郊野公园的渔农自然护理署（AFCD）负责管理。游客必须使用当地在线旅游预订平台Klook客路进行实名登记，当局表示这一要求是为了防止倒票和缺席。登记者将收到附有二维码的电子优惠券，必须在破边洲路段入口处向渔护署人员出示该优惠券。人满为患 香港的热门自然景点一直在努力应对过度旅游的问题，尤其是在中国大陆游客的旅游旺季。 2026年5月2日，中国大陆劳动节黄金周假期第二天，西贡咸田海滩。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。尤其是西贡的一些小径和海滩——以其美丽的海岸景色和自然景观而闻名——已经出现了重大瓶颈，因为公共交通难以跟上需求的激增。环保组织还警告过度拥挤会对生态系统造成损害。当局在六月份首次表示，他们正在探索引入实名预订系统，以改善破边洲的客流管理。环境及生态局副局长黄黛妮表示，渔护署人员一直在进行人流控制，在游客人数达到上限时阻止人们进入，但这种做法对于促进香港生态旅游而言并不理想。

title.en: First tender awarded for major NM plot for HK$1.03b
title.zh: 新墨西哥州主要地块首次招标，价格为 1.03b 港元

summary.en: The government has awarded the first tender for a major land parcel in the Northern Metropolis. The Development Bureau announced on Monday that the site, located in the Hung Shui Kiu/Ha Tsuen New Development Area, goes to HSK New Development Limited with a bid price of HK$1.03...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: The government has awarded the first tender for a major land parcel in the Northern Metropolis. The Development Bureau announced on Monday that the site, located in the Hung Shui Kiu/Ha Tsuen New Development Area, goes to HSK New Development Limited with a bid price of HK$1.03 billion. The winning consortium comprises six shareholders: China Overseas Land and Investment, China Merchants Land, China Resources Land, China Travel Service, JD.com and a subsidiary of Sino Land. The project, featuring nearly 11 hectares, is the first "large-scale land disposal" under the Northern Metropolis. Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn said the consortium brings together major property developers and industry leaders from other sectors. "The six companies have joined forces and cast a vote of confidence in the Northern Metropolis through concrete action, ushering in a promising start for the diversified development model," Linn said. The winning bidder will be responsible for flattening and developing three residential sites that can yield about 3,000 flats, with an average size of 50 square metres each. It will also build a smart logistics centre on an "Enterprise and Technology Park" site, with a total floor area of 50,950 square metres. JD.com will be the anchor tenant, with operations starting within 55 months – well ahead of the 96-month minimum requirement in the tender documents. The three residential sites and one Enterprise and Technology Park site, totalling about 3.6 hectares, will be granted to the consortium on 50-year leases. The consortium estimates the entire project involves about HK$16.8 billion in investment and will create more than 6,000 jobs. It has chosen to pay the full land premium within 28 days, rather than in instalments. The government received two bids for the tender exercise which ended in July. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 政府已授予北部大都市一块主要地块的首次招标。发展局周一公布，位于洪水桥/厦村新发展区的地皮落予HSK新发展有限公司，竞投价为10.3亿港元。中标财团由六家股东组成：中国海外发展、招商局置地、华润置地、中国旅行社、京东以及信和置业的子公司。该项目占地近11公顷，是北方都市圈首个“大规模土地出让”。发展局局长伯纳黛特·林恩 (Bernadette Linn) 表示，该财团汇集了主要房地产开发商和其他行业的行业领导者。 “六家企业强强联手，以实际行动为北方都市投下了信任票，为多元化发展模式开启了良好的开局。”林恩说。中标者将负责平整和开发三块住宅用地，可建造约3,000套公寓，每块平均面积为50平方米。还将在“企业科技园”用地建设智慧物流中心，总建筑面积50,950平方米。京东将成为主要租户，并在 55 个月内开始运营——远远早于招标文件中 96 个月的最低要求。这三块住宅用地和一处企业科技园用地总计约3.6公顷，将以50年的租约授予该财团。该财团预计整个项目投资约168亿港元，将创造超过6,000个就业机会。它选择在 28 天内支付全额土地出让金，而不是分期付款。政府在七月结束的招标活动中收到了两份标书。埃德蒙·方编辑

title.en: Dental outreach at kindergartens begins on Sep 1
title.zh: 幼儿园牙科外展活动将于 9 月 1 日开始

summary.en: Preschoolers are set to receive oral check-ups for free on campus starting in the coming academic year on September 1, the Department of Health said on Monday. Under the newly launched Outreach Oral Health Programme, 23 designated service providers will head to kindergartens to...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Preschoolers are set to receive oral check-ups for free on campus starting in the coming academic year on September 1, the Department of Health said on Monday. Under the newly launched Outreach Oral Health Programme, 23 designated service providers will head to kindergartens to offer dental and preventive services for those aged three to six on an annual basis. With the aim of cultivating early childhood dental care with the help of parents, they will also provide parents a report of their children's dental health, as well referral services for those in need. Reports of children with tooth decay will also come with tailor-made care advice. In addition, outreach teams will also offer seminars on dental health for teachers free or charge, in a bid to raise children's awareness towards oral care. So far, 680 kindergartens have signed up for the scheme — accounting for 71.7 percent of the city's total. Dr Alex Chau, a senior dental officer (Community Dental Service) from the department, said some kindergartens decided not to join because they have already arranged similar services themselves. "And second one is that the kindergarten may be moving from one school, physically moving from one campus to another campus, or maybe the school is closing," he said. "So they may be busy with other issues." But the providers will continue to reach out to these preschools to encourage them to sign up to the programme, he added. With the roll out of the programme, preventive dental services that are either offered for free or subsidised by the department now cover all age groups. The scheme was the latest one following the launch of the Primary Dental Co-care Pilot Scheme for Adolescents in March last year. Dr Kitty Hse, a consultant in-charge of dental services from the department, said that as of August 12, some 10,000 teenagers had undergone checkups at dentists covered under the scheme. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 卫生部周一表示，从下一学年 9 月 1 日开始，学龄前儿童将在校园内接受免费口腔检查。新推出的口腔健康外展计划，每年将有23家指定服务机构前往幼稚园，为3至6岁的儿童提供牙科和预防服务。为了在家长的帮助下培养幼儿牙科护理，他们还将为家长提供孩子牙齿健康的报告，并为有需要的人提供转介服务。关于儿童蛀牙的报告还将附有量身定制的护理建议。此外，外展团队还将为教师免费或收费举办牙齿健康讲座，以提高孩子们对口腔护理的认识。截至目前，已有680所幼儿园报名参加，占全市幼儿园总数的71.7%。该署高级牙科主任（社区牙科服务）周俊杰医生表示，部分幼稚园决定不参加，因为他们自己已经安排了类似的服务。 “第二个问题是，幼儿园可能会从一所学校搬迁，从一个校区搬到另一个校区，或者学校可能会关闭，”他说。 “所以他们可能忙于其他问题。”但他补充说，服务提供者将继续与这些幼儿园联系，鼓励他们报名参加该计划。随着该计划的推出，免费或由该部门补贴的预防性牙科服务现已覆盖所有年龄段。该计划是继去年三月推出青少年牙科共同护理试验计划后的最新计划。该署负责牙科服务的顾问谢洁仪医生表示，截至8月12日，已有约1万名青少年在计划覆盖的牙医处接受检查。托尼·萨宾编辑

title.en: HK, mainland 'seriously impressive' in broadcasting
title.zh: 香港和内地在广播方面“令人印象深刻”

summary.en: Asia-Pacific Broadcasting Union secretary-general Ahmed Nadeem praised the level of Hong Kong and mainland broadcast expertise on Monday, saying their experience would help raise standards across the region's airwaves. Speaking on RTHK's Backchat programme, he said the mainland...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Asia-Pacific Broadcasting Union secretary-general Ahmed Nadeem praised the level of Hong Kong and mainland broadcast expertise on Monday, saying their experience would help raise standards across the region's airwaves. Speaking on RTHK's Backchat programme, he said the mainland sector's technological level in play is "seriously impressive”. State broadcasters, Nadeem added, have implemented advanced technology across different stages of the broadcasting chain, marking a major shift from traditional broadcasting systems. Citing state broadcaster CCTV as an example, he said the pace of transformation on the mainland has been remarkable when compared with some countries that still rely on older broadcast infrastructure. “If you go to countries like Bangladesh or Pakistan, you still see the old traditional set-ups," whereas on the mainland "the level of change you see from traditional broadcasting set-ups to those [countries] is remarkable,” he said. Nadeem also pointed out that Hong Kong has clear strengths in the use of technology, content creation and development. He said the city's broadcasters are not only aware of international training concepts but already applying many of them in their daily practices. "When you talk about broadcasting and media, the way they [Hong Kong and the mainland] approach and the way the kind of technologies they have, they use in creating content, in developing content, and broadcasting by itself is really an opportunity for others to come and learn," Nadeem said. He said this makes the SAR an important source of expertise for less developed broadcasting markets in the region. Collaboration, he added, will remain essential as broadcasters compete with global streaming platforms and artificial intelligence, stressing that traditional broadcasters still have deep archives, production expertise and strong public trust – assets that can be strengthened through regional cooperation. Nadeem also commended the performance by Hong Kong universities that took part in the ABU Robocon 2026 over the weekend, saying they "bring new knowledge to the scene". "The way they work and how they've done, how they have approached the project is very different from smaller countries or universities," he said. "It's a huge opportunity for everybody to actually see because they all work in their own universities, they're not coming and talking to each other when they're designing the robots," he said. Nadeem said teams had different approaches, strategies and points of views, designing their robots based on their backgrounds and experiences, and that this will ultimately promote creative and technological changes among them. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 亚太广播联盟秘书长艾哈迈德·纳迪姆周一赞扬了香港和内地广播专业水平，称他们的经验将有助于提高该地区广播电视的标准。他在香港电台的 Backchat 节目中表示，内地行业的技术水平“令人印象深刻”。纳迪姆补充说，国家广播公司已经在广播链的不同阶段实施了先进技术，标志着传统广播系统的重大转变。他以国家电视台中央电视台为例表示，与一些仍然依赖旧广播基础设施的国家相比，中国大陆的转型步伐是惊人的。 “如果你去孟加拉国或巴基斯坦等国家，你仍然会看到古老的传统设置，”而在大陆，“你看到的从传统广播设置到这些国家的变化程度是惊人的，”他说。 Nadeem还指出，香港在科技运用、内容创作和发展方面具有明显优势。他说，该市的广播公司不仅了解国际培训概念，而且已经将其中的许多概念应用到日常实践中。纳迪姆说：“当你谈论广播和媒体时，他们（香港和大陆）的处理方式以及他们在创作内容、开发内容和广播本身时使用的技术方式确实是其他人前来学习的机会。”他说，这使得特区成为该地区欠发达广播市场的重要专业知识来源。他补充说，随着广播公司与全球流媒体平台和人工智能竞争，合作仍然至关重要，并强调传统广播公司仍然拥有深厚的档案、制作专业知识和强大的公众信任——这些资产可以通过区域合作得到加强。 Nadeem还赞扬了周末参加ABU Robocon 2026的香港大学的表现，称他们“为现场带来了新知识”。他说：“他们的工作方式、工作方式、实施项目的方式与较小的国家或大学非常不同。” “这对每个人来说都是一个真正看到的巨大机会，因为他们都在自己的大学工作，在设计机器人时他们不会过来互相交谈，”他说。纳迪姆表示，团队有不同的方法、策略和观点，根据他们的背景和经验设计机器人，这最终将促进他们之间的创造性和技术变革。托尼·萨宾编辑

title.en: ‘She’s not afraid of anyone’: the prison writings of one of Hong Kong’s last outspoken democracy activists
title.zh: “她无所畏惧”：香港最后一位直言不讳的民主活动家之一的狱中手稿

summary.en: Chow Hang-tung, a prominent Hong Kong democracy activist, has been detained since 2021. From prison, she continues to write on various topics, including the meaning of freedom and the Tiananmen Square events, despite being found guilty of “inciting subversion.”
summary.zh: 香港著名民主活动家邹幸彤自2021年起被拘留。尽管被判“煽动颠覆罪”，她仍在狱中笔耕不辍，撰写关于自由的意义和天安门事件等各种主题的文章。

body.en: Chow Hang-tung has been detained since 2021, and written about everything from clothes to Tiananmen Square and the meaning of freedom Tiananmen Square vigil organisers in Hong Kong found guilty of ‘inciting subversion’ In one essay written from prison, Chow Hang-tung worries about her hairstyle before court appearances because there are no combs or mirrors in her cell. “In a place like prison, where anything that is personal is stripped away, it’s even more important to hold on to every means by which you can express yourself,” she writes. “Don’t let uniform, depersonalised rules, dress codes, schedules, and behavioural requirements grind down your edges and mould you into a ‘model citizen’”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 周恒东自 2021 年以来一直被拘留，并撰写了从服装到天安门广场以及自由的意义等各种内容。香港天安门广场守夜活动组织者被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。在一篇在狱中写的文章中，周恒东对自己出庭前的发型感到担忧，因为她的牢房里没有梳子或镜子。 “在监狱这样的地方，任何个人的东西都被剥夺了，更重要的是要坚持一切可以表达自己的方式，”她写道。 “不要让统一的、非个性化的规则、着装规范、时间表和行为要求磨掉你的棱角，把你塑造成‘模范公民’”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The unwavering spirit of activists like Chow Hang-tung, who continue to speak truth from confinement, reminds us of the biblical call to advocate for the vulnerable. Yahweh's word encourages us to be a voice for those who cannot speak for themselves, especially the destitute and those whose rights are denied. Her writings from prison embody a profound...
reflection.zh: 邹幸彤等活动家在囚禁中仍坚定不移地发出真理之声，这提醒我们圣经呼召我们要为弱势群体发声。雅伟的话语鼓励我们为那些不能为自己说话的人，特别是贫困和权利被剥夺的人，开口辩护。她在狱中的文字体现了对正义和自由的深刻承诺，即使为此付出个人代价。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Long-term study reveals hidden threat of schistosomiasis in endangered chimpanzees
title.zh: 长期研究揭示濒危黑猩猩隐藏的血吸虫病威胁

summary.en: A 12-year study of rescued chimpanzees at the Ngamba Island Chimpanzee Sanctuary (NICS) in Uganda has revealed persistent intestinal schistosomiasis infections, highlighting the need for long-term disease surveillance to protect endangered wildlife.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

A 12-year study of rescued chimpanzees at the Ngamba Island Chimpanzee Sanctuary (NICS) in Uganda has revealed persistent intestinal schistosomiasis infections, highlighting the need for long-term disease surveillance to protect endangered wildlife.

The study, led by researchers at the Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine (LSTM) and international collaborators, followed almost 50 chimpanzees living on Ngamba Island in Lake Victoria, where intestinal schistosomiasis is highly endemic. The disease is transmitted by infected snails along the shoreline, presenting an ongoing health challenge for the chimpanzees and the people who care for them.

Although annual praziquantel treatment reduced infections, it was not enough to prevent ongoing transmission or progressive liver disease. Ultrasound examinations revealed worsening liver fibrosis in several animals, including advanced "pipe-stem" fibrosis, a severe and irreversible form of liver damage more commonly associated with long-standing human infection.

The findings, published in Parasitology , suggest that relying on treatment alone is unlikely to fully protect animals living in endemic areas. Instead, a One Health approach that provides more frequent treatment, regular health monitoring and environmental management is needed to safeguard their long-term welfare.

The work also reinforces lessons from human schistosomiasis control programs around Lake Victoria, where repeated reinfection continues to limit progress despite widespread treatment campaigns. The researchers hope their findings will encourage greater disease surveillance in chimpanzee sanctuaries across Africa and help inform future conservation and veterinary management strategies.

Dr. Alexandra Juhász, lead author of the study and director of LSTM's MSc One Health in Tropical Disease, said, "Chimpanzees are a prominent endangered species globally, so maintaining their health is a conservation priority. We found that annual praziquantel treatment alone is not enough within an environment where animals are constantly exposed to infected water. More frequent treatment, alongside regular monitoring, could help prevent the severe fibrotic liver damage we observed.

"Our study also demonstrates the value of a One Health approach. The same parasite infects both humans and chimpanzees, while infected snails maintain transmission in the environment. Understanding how these systems interact helps us protect wildlife while improving our understanding of human schistosomiasis more broadly."

title.en: Dry landscapes and newly fallowed fields may raise California Valley fever risk
title.zh: 干燥的土地和新休耕的土地可能会增加加州山谷热病的风险

summary.en: Researchers at UC San Diego and UC Berkeley have found that certain landscapes surrounding California communities are associated with differing rates of Valley fever, a fungal respiratory infection caused by inhaling spores carried in windblown dust.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Researchers at UC San Diego and UC Berkeley have found that certain landscapes surrounding California communities are associated with differing rates of Valley fever, a fungal respiratory infection caused by inhaling spores carried in windblown dust.

Naturally dry, sparsely vegetated landscapes and some types of farmland were associated with higher disease rates, while other agricultural land uses were associated with lower rates. The findings also suggest that fallowing farmland may influence Valley fever rates in some circumstances.

"California is undergoing a major transformation of its agricultural landscape, and we need to understand how those changes may affect public health," said Alexandra Heaney, Ph.D., assistant professor at the Herbert Wertheim School of Public Health and Human Longevity Science at UC San Diego and first author of the study. "Our findings suggest that land management decisions can have consequences that extend beyond agriculture and water use. As more land is taken out of production, we may see health risks and therefore have the opportunity to build prevention measures into how California's landscapes are managed."

Valley fever is caused by Coccidioides, a fungus that grows in soil across parts of California and the southwestern United States. When soil is disturbed by wind, farming, digging or construction, tiny fungal spores can become airborne and be inhaled, making people who inhale them sick. It's important to note that Valley fever does not spread from person to person.

In California, rates of Valley fever have increased by more than 800% over the past two decades. While many people who inhale the spores never develop symptoms, those who do can experience a debilitating respiratory illness lasting weeks to months. A small share of infections become severe, spreading beyond the lungs or causing serious long-term lung disease.

The highest burden of Valley fever in California occurs in the southern San Joaquin Valley—one of the most productive agricultural regions in the world—where drought, water scarcity and groundwater regulations are driving changes in land use, including the fallowing of some farmland.

To investigate how these changes may relate to disease, researchers analyzed 65,657 confirmed Valley fever cases reported to the California Department of Public Health between April 2008 and March 2021. The cases were linked to high-resolution maps showing natural vegetation, crop types and fallowed fields across 20 California counties where Valley fever was more common. title.en: Immigration can bring small overall gains but uneven wage effects
title.zh: 移民带来的总体收益较小，但工资影响不均衡

summary.en: Immigration can produce a small economic gain for the native-born population overall while causing larger shifts in wages between different groups of workers, according to new research co-authored by King's Business School.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Immigration can produce a small economic gain for the native-born population overall while causing larger shifts in wages between different groups of workers, according to new research co-authored by King's Business School.

The model predicts that wages fall in lower-paid occupations, where migrant workers are overrepresented, and rise elsewhere. The findings suggest that headline averages can conceal important differences across the labor market.

In the paper , "The Immigration Surplus Revisited," researchers revisit the "immigration surplus," the idea that immigration can benefit the native-born population overall. First proposed by economist George Borjas in 1995, the theory suggests that immigration delivers an aggregate economic gain for previous residents, even though that gain may not be shared equally.

The paper, accepted for publication in The Economic Journal , shows that this result holds under a much wider range of economic conditions than previously established. This includes different mixes of workers and capital, different relationships between them, and situations in which immigration changes the prices of goods as well as wages.

Using U.S. data, the researchers estimated that increasing total employment by 1% through immigration would create an overall gain for the native-born population equal to around 0.01% of earnings. Although the overall benefit is small, the effects on wages in different occupations can be larger.

How those effects are distributed depends on the skills that migrants bring. If migrant and native-born workers have the same mix of skills, the model predicts no overall surplus and no redistribution between native-born workers. As the differences between the two groups increase, so does the overall gain, but the effects on relative wages also become greater.

Because governments often influence the skill mix of immigration, the findings suggest that policy choices help determine both the overall economic effect and how wage gains and pressures are distributed across the labor market.

The paper also cautions against using wages alone to judge whether workers have benefited. Immigration can move native-born workers into better-paid jobs, but the additional pay may compensate for extra training or less attractive work. A higher wage does not therefore necessarily mean that someone is better off overall.

body.en: Common medications may reshape the gut microbiome long after the last dose is taken. In a study of more than 2,500 people, researchers found lasting microbial changes linked not only to antibiotics, but also to antidepressants, beta-blockers, acid-reducing drugs, and benzodiazepines. Some effects were still detectable years later, suggesting past medication use may strongly influence the gut bacteria people carry today.
body.zh: 常见药物可能会在服用最后一剂药物后很长时间内重塑肠道微生物组。在一项对 2,500 多人进行的研究中，研究人员发现持久的微生物变化不仅与抗生素有关，还与抗抑郁药、β-受体阻滞剂、降酸药和苯二氮卓类药物有关。几年后仍然可以检测到一些影响，这表明过去的药物使用可能会强烈影响人们今天携带的肠道细菌。

While each pair eclipses its own two stars, as usual, only one pair eclipses the other. A paper outlining the properties of this unique system was submitted to the arXiv preprint server on Aug. 13. It has been accepted for publication in the journal Astronomy & Astrophysics.

title.en: Bird flu is spreading. Your backyard feeder could make it worse
title.zh: 禽流感正在蔓延。你的后院喂食器可能会让情况变得更糟

summary.en: Backyard bird feeders could become unexpected hotspots for H5N1 as Australia’s bird flu outbreak spreads, bringing species together in ways that rarely occur naturally. Experts say stopping feeding is safest, while smaller amounts of food, no hand-feeding, and careful cleaning...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Backyard bird feeding is one of our country’s most popular pastimes. Research reveals about half of Australian households feed wild birds, with many people doing so daily.

However, this practice could act as a superspreader event – where a disease infects an unusually high number of people or animals – of the H5N1 virus. This deadly strain of bird flu has already decimated wild bird and mammal populations worldwide. It is now spreading across Australia, most recently killing more than 1,000 crested terns and a long-nosed fur seal, the first detection in a mainland mammal.

Although many Australians feed wild birds, the practice is controversial . This is mainly due to concerns about people offering unsuitable foods and birds becoming dependent on humans.

So why is backyard bird feeding such a problem when it comes to bird flu? And can we do it safely?

People feed wild birds for various reasons , including to provide food during tough times or simply enjoy their presence. Most care deeply about their avian companions and believe feeding them is helpful .

Feeding wild birds heightens the risk of disease transmission at feeding locations . When we offer supplementary food, such as seeds or meat scraps, this attracts birds of many different species in a combination and number that would not happen in nature. They may carry deadly diseases, such as the H5N1 virus, and potentially spread them to other birds.

This can create a transmission hotspot right on our back deck. And catching bird flu can push our most threatened species, such as the orange-bellied parrot , to the brink of extinction.

The fatal effects of H5N1 are not only contained to birds. Scavenger animals such as possums, red foxes and crows can be exposed to the virus while devouring the carcasses of infected birds. Humans in close contact with infected wildlife, such as wildlife carers and veterinarians, can contract H5N1. However, human infection is rare and typically only causes mild symptoms.

Backyard bird feeding may seem like a harmless hobby. But given how many people do it, and the risks it poses to both birds and people, bird feeding activities could lead to many more wildlife deaths .

The most effective strategy is to stop feeding birds altogether. If you don’t offer food to wild birds, they will be less likely to congregate in your backyard or garden. And they will be fine without your help. Our previous research found most birds that visit feeders obtain most of their nutrition from natural sources, such as insects and worms. So the food we provide is a snack, not an essential meal.

Having feeders full of seeds and leftover meat will attract more birds. So to discourage them from congregating, simply provide less food. Much like COVID-era social...
body.zh: 后院喂鸟是我国最受欢迎的消遣之一。研究显示，大约一半的澳大利亚家庭喂养野生鸟类，其中许多人每天都这样做。 然而，这种做法可能会成为 H5N1 病毒的超级传播事件——一种疾病感染异常多的人或动物。这种致命的禽流感病毒已经导致世界各地的野生鸟类和哺乳动物数量大量减少。它目前正在澳大利亚各地蔓延，最近导致 1,000 多只凤头燕鸥和一只长鼻海豹死亡，这是首次在大陆哺乳动物中发现这种病毒。 尽管许多澳大利亚人喂养野生鸟类，但这种做法存在争议。这主要是由于担心人们提供不合适的食物以及鸟类变得依赖人类。 那么，为什么在禽流感方面，后院喂鸟会成为一个问题呢？我们可以安全地做到这一点吗？ 人们出于各种原因喂养野生鸟类，包括在困难时期提供食物或只是享受它们的存在。大多数人非常关心他们的鸟类同伴，并相信喂养它们是有帮助的。 喂养野鸟会增加喂养地点疾病传播的风险。当我们提供补充食物（例如种子或肉末）时，会吸引许多不同物种的鸟类，其组合和数量在自然界中是不会发生的。它们可能携带致命疾病，例如 H5N1 病毒，并有可能将其传播给其他鸟类。 这可以在我们的后甲板上创建一个传输热点。感染禽流感可能会将橙腹鹦鹉等最受威胁的物种推向灭绝的边缘。 H5N1 的致命影响不仅限于鸟类。负鼠、红狐和乌鸦等食腐动物在吞食受感染鸟类的尸体时可能会接触到病毒。与受感染野生动物密切接触的人类，例如野生动物护理人员和兽医，可能会感染 H5N1。然而，人类感染很少见，通常只会引起轻微症状。 后院喂鸟似乎是一种无害的爱好。但考虑到有多少人这样做，以及它对鸟类和人类造成的风险，鸟类喂养活动可能会导致更多野生动物死亡。 最有效的策略是完全停止喂养鸟类。如果您不向野鸟提供食物，它们就不太可能聚集在您的后院或花园里。没有你的帮助，他们也会没事的。我们之前的研究发现，大多数访问喂食器的鸟类从昆虫和蠕虫等天然来源获取大部分营养。所以我们提供的食物是零食，而不是必需的膳食。 装满种子和剩余肉的喂食器会吸引更多的鸟类。因此，为了阻止他们聚集，只需提供更少的食物即可。就像新冠病毒时代的社交......

title.en: A ghostly ribbon of stars reveals hidden dark matter
title.zh: 一条幽灵般的星带揭示了隐藏的暗物质

summary.en: A faint ribbon of stars around a distant galaxy has become the first globular cluster stellar stream ever identified beyond the Milky Way. Because the stars trace the galaxy’s gravity, researchers used the stream to estimate how much invisible dark matter surrounds it and how...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
For billions of years, an ancient cluster of stars has been gradually coming apart, shedding stars that now form a faint, narrow ribbon across space. That delicate structure is offering astronomers a new way to investigate one of the universe's biggest mysteries.

An international research team, including an astrophysicist from Northwestern University, has identified the first stellar stream of this type ever observed outside the Milky Way. Astronomers have long predicted that such streams should exist around other galaxies, but their extreme faintness has made them difficult to detect.

The newly discovered stream also offers scientists an unusual tool for studying dark matter, which remains one of the major unanswered questions in astrophysics. By analyzing the stream's shape, researchers reconstructed the gravitational field of its host galaxy and used that information to determine how unseen dark matter influenced the stars' paths.

The findings could eventually help scientists investigate how dark matter is distributed across many different galaxies and throughout the universe.

"The stars in a stellar stream all travel along nearly the same orbit, and that orbit is shaped by the galaxy's gravity," said Northwestern's Tjitske Starkenburg, who coauthored the study. "By modeling that gravity, we can estimate the galaxy's total mass. We already know roughly how much of that mass comes from visible matter like stars, so the rest must be dark matter."

Starkenburg, an expert in extragalactic astronomy, is a research assistant professor at Northwestern's Center for Interdisciplinary Exploration and Research in Astrophysics. The study was co-led by Julie Kiel Holm of the University of Copenhagen and Sarah Pearson of the Technical University of Denmark.

Globular clusters are densely packed groups of stars held together by gravity. As one of these clusters travels around its host galaxy, the galaxy's gravitational pull can slowly strip stars away from it.

Those stars do not simply scatter in every direction. Instead, they tend to continue along nearly the same orbital path, creating long, thin stellar streams that retain information about the gravitational forces they have experienced.

Astronomers have identified dozens of streams produced by globular clusters inside the Milky Way. Until now, however, no comparable stream had been detected in another galaxy. Such structures are generally so faint that they disappear against the light of their host galaxies.

The breakthrough came through archival observations from NASA's Hubble Space Telescope presented by study coauthors David Sand and Catherine Fielder, both astronomers at the University of Arizona. While study coauthor David Hendel was examining images of the ultra-diffuse galaxy UGC 9050-Dw1 for...
body.zh: 数十亿年来，古老的星团逐渐分裂，脱落的恒星现在在太空中形成一条微弱而狭窄的丝带。这种微妙的结构为天文学家提供了一种研究宇宙最大谜团之一的新方法。 包括西北大学天体物理学家在内的一个国际研究小组发现了在银河系外首次观测到的此类恒星流。天文学家长期以来一直预测，此类流应该存在于其他星系周围，但它们的极度微弱使它们难以被发现。 新发现的暗物质流还为科学家提供了一种不寻常的工具来研究暗物质，暗物质仍然是天体物理学中尚未解答的主要问题之一。通过分析该流的形状，研究人员重建了其宿主星系的引力场，并利用该信息来确定看不见的暗物质如何影响恒星的路径。 这些发现最终可以帮助科学家研究暗物质如何分布在许多不同的星系和整个宇宙中。 “恒星流中的恒星都沿着几乎相同的轨道运行，而该轨道是由星系的引力决定的，”西北大学的蒂斯克·斯塔肯堡（Tjitske Starkenburg）说，他是这项研究的合著者。 “通过对引力进行建模，我们可以估计星系的总质量。我们已经大致知道其中有多少质量来自恒星等可见物质，所以其余的一定是暗物质。” 斯塔肯伯格是河外天文学专家，西北大学天体物理学跨学科探索与研究中心的研究助理教授。这项研究由哥本哈根大学的 Julie Kiel Holm 和丹麦技术大学的 Sarah Pearson 共同领导。 球状星团是由重力聚集在一起的密集恒星团。当这些星团之一围绕其宿主星系运行时，星系的引力会慢慢地将恒星从它身上剥离。 这些星星并不简单地分散在各个方向。相反，它们倾向于继续沿着几乎相同的轨道路径运行，产生又长又细的恒星流，保留有关它们所经历的引力的信息。 天文学家已经发现了银河系内部球状星团产生的数十条流。然而，到目前为止，尚未在另一个星系中检测到类似的流。这些结构通常非常微弱，以至于它们在宿主星系的光线下消失了。 这一突破来自美国宇航局哈勃太空望远镜的档案观测，该观测由研究合著者、亚利桑那大学的天文学家大卫·桑德和凯瑟琳·菲尔德提出。当研究合著者 David Hendel 正在检查超漫射星系 UGC 9050-Dw1 的图像时……

But researchers say that they have succeeded in creating such a product as part of a Nasa-funded project aimed at feeding astronauts on future space missions. The technology uses specially designed yeasts to transform plastics and agricultural waste into edible proteins, fats and flavourings. The resulting slurry is passed through a 3D printer to create a disc-shaped “cookie”. Continue reading...
